title: French transcription: language setting, model download and per-session language
description: Add French as a transcription language (goal 1, multilingual), using the French streaming zipformer already in `ModelCatalog.ASR_FR`.
steps: In `SettingsScreen` replace the disabled language row with a two-option `SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow` "English" / "Français" bound to `AppSettings.asrLanguage` ("en"/"fr"), saved immediately via `repo.update`. French has no NPU model: when Français is selected show "French uses the CPU engine." under the engine selector (the engine setting itself is kept; `ModelCatalog.effectiveEngine` already maps French to CPU).

Make sure `ModelSetupViewModel` takes the bundles from `ModelCatalog.requiredFor(language, engine)` for the current settings (pass them from the factory). `MainActivity` and the home FAB already use the setting's language, so choosing French with its model missing leads to `setup`, which downloads only the missing French bundle (≈71 MB) — update the setup text to show the real size of the missing bundles: `store.missing(bundles).sumOf { it.totalBytes }`.

In Settings, under the language selector, show the model status for the selected language: "Model installed" or "Model not downloaded (N MB) – it will be downloaded before your next recording". Add a "Delete French model" text button when French is installed and English is selected (calls `modelStore.delete(ModelCatalog.ASR_FR)`).

`RecordingController` already passes the language to the factory and saves it on the session; show the language code in `sessionSubtitle` as a suffix `" · FR"` only when the language is not "en" (add a `language` parameter, update its tests).
Ensure `TextNormalizer` handles French accented upper-case (e.g. "ÉTÉ" → "Été") — add a test; use `lowercase(Locale.ROOT)`/`replaceFirstChar { it.titlecase(Locale.ROOT) }`.
Add tests in `ui/setup/ModelSetupViewModelTest.kt` (only missing bundles are requested; totalBytes equals the missing sum) and `ui/home/SessionSubtitleTest.kt`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: with the English bundles installed and language "fr" (engine "npu"), `requiredFor` returns the Kroko French bundle and the setup ViewModel requests only `asr-fr-kroko-2025-08-06` with `totalBytes == 71052319`
Test: subtitle for a French session ends with `" · FR"`, English sessions have no language suffix
Settings screen shows the English/Français selector (visible in `SettingsScreen.kt`)
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine. Only reference sherpa classes inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
